title: AcceptanceCriterion
description: One observable behavior. Tagged API / E2E / Infra. Maps to one or more scenarios in the test list.

layer.description: Which layer the AC exercises. Assigned by the Architect Reviewer in phase 7.1 (NOT written by the spec-author, so it is optional at spec time; the architect self-check and the design gate require it once the architect has run).

scenarios.description: Scenario filenames or IDs that exercise this AC.

architectural_notes.description: Layer assignment rationale, cross-cutting concerns touched, owner module.

ui_seams.description: For an E2E / client AC: the ia.md data-testid seam token(s) this AC's UI must drive (e.g. stock-cell-tracking, sku-par-level). Declared by the Architect Reviewer; the deterministic pre-reflect IA gate checks every one is named in ia.md, so an AC that asserts a surface the information architecture does not define is caught before the LLM reflect lap. Omit for a non-UI (API/Infra) AC.

independence.description: Determination that this AC's `then` is NOT already delivered, implied, or duplicated by an earlier AC in the same story (the AC-independence test). Required for every AC after the first in a story (the spec gate hard-blocks a later AC that omits it or sets distinct_from_prior:false); the first AC has no prior and may omit it.

distinct_from_prior.description: True iff this AC can go RED while every earlier AC in the story is GREEN (and vice versa). False means its outcome is already produced by an earlier AC's build and must be folded or re-scoped.

rationale.description: One line: the distinct, independently-RED-able outcome this AC adds beyond the earlier ACs.
